items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: He used to play with Benny, Charlie Wilson.

ctx.x: What about old Alfonso Trent? Did you ever hear him? Trent's band? Trent's band. They played around Texas.

Yeah, Trent's band. They was around Texas. Well Boots and his brothers and Trent's and all of them, well he used to tie up there in Orange and around Houston, he used to be around Houston a lot. Well with all them bands, he had big bands too. Yeah. And with them bands, they was like a socialite, or a real orchestra, you understand, on that music key, you understand. Well what about Alvin Walls, was that a socialite kind of band? Well it's mostly a dance band, and you know, on the cocktail side, soft music. Well…
